execution: Only after independent-development admission excludes the fixed confirmation window and the actual scheduler claims this code/data/policy binding. One worker, no replay.
window_reason: Eight unscored days cover startup_candle_count=176 and lagged 168-hour volatility. Both new controls share the same window; earlier Jan8 parent results are not a same-window causal comparator.
training: No parameters are fitted. The Jan2026 boundary is a descriptive development-period split only, not independent validation.

rules.shock: Z_t=sum(r_(t-6)..r_(t-1))/(std_population(r_(t-168)..r_(t-1))*sqrt(6)); no current return in shock or volatility
rules.shock_rebound: Long Z_t<=-2 and r_t>0; short Z_t>=2 and r_t<0. All required data finite, available and volume positive.
rules.pressure: B=taker-buy base-asset volume, V=total base-asset volume. Q_t=(2*B_t-V_t)/V_t; Q_pre=(2*sum(B_(t-6)..B_(t-1))-sum(V_(t-6)..V_(t-1)))/sum(V_(t-6)..V_(t-1)).
rules.flow_turn: Same price entry as shock_rebound; additionally long Q_pre<0 and Q_t>0, short Q_pre>0 and Q_t<0. Exact zero fails the transition. No magnitude tuning.
rules.exit: No channel exit and no ROI schedule; native custom_exit requests holding_12h at current_time-open_date_utc>=12h. Inherited native -20% stoploss may exit earlier. End-of-data force_exit may shorten the final holding period; actual last exit can be end-1h and is disclosed.
rules.unknown: Zero denominators or unavailable data never become zero-valued factors. Loader rejects malformed/absent source. No imputation and no factor selected from returns.

cost_and_execution.funding: Cost only, no sign filter: exact raw event milliseconds and official settlement mark, open<event<=close. Event precedes equal-time fills; native formula/shared wallet and independent fill audit are reused.
cost_and_execution.stress: Additional 4bp per side on the same native fills only; this is arithmetic sensitivity, not another native run.
cost_and_execution.precision: Native market minimum, rounding, balance clamp and stop mechanics; current instrument rules are a declared historical assumption. Native OHLCV bars do not prove intrahour liquidity or execution.

timing.source: Completed candle open t; all same-hour price and taker fields declared available at t+1h+60s
timing.entry: One explicit signal shift plus Freqtrade next-bar shift: earliest actual native entry t+2h
timing.provenance: Historical available_at is an assumption, fetched_at is the actual 2026-09-08 capture. No historical point-in-time publication archive exists. Loader requires the original receipt and OHLCV hashes and rejects any forward-vintage root.
timing.future_isolation: Never read or select from fixed confirmation-window prices, signals, trades, equity or summaries. No replay of the confirmed candidate, no change to its registration/window/reservation, no second confirmation.

risk: Keep existing 20% target / 30% review classification. Slightly above 20% requires explanation, not automatic deletion. Report drawdown duration, hourly MTM limits, pair/direction concentration, exposure, turnover, stress and liquidation events. No live-risk increase is authorized by this experiment.
sample_rule: flow_turn needs at least 30 native position cycles and at least 12 synchronized 72h entry clusters. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED regardless of economic sign; these floors do not claim statistical significance.
support_rule: Only LIMITED_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT if sample floor passes AND flow_turn gross_price_effect_usdt>0 AND net_usdt>0 AND flow_turn net_usdt-shock_rebound net_usdt>0. Full accounting/source/causality must pass. Exposure and retained-event changes prevent interpreting net difference as isolated pure factor alpha.
stop_rule: Any source/causal/accounting fault is BLOCKED. Insufficient samples are UNDERPOWERED. Otherwise failure of any economic support condition closes this hypothesis as NO_INCREMENTAL_COST_SUPPORT_STOP_BRANCH. Negative gross and negative complete-cost cases are reported explicitly. Never retune shock, lookbacks, pressure or exit after seeing results.
unique_next_if_supported: 仅做该开发机制的仓位与成交成本归因复核；固定 carry_nonpaying 的现有未来确认预约继续按原协议观察，不开第二确认、不改候选和窗口。
unique_next_if_stopped: 关闭冲击反转加主动成交转换分支；唯一后续研究审查为已归档资金费变化机制是否具有独立、可证伪且数据可用的假说，审查前不生成市场任务；既有 carry_nonpaying 确认预约保持。
forbidden: label taker volume as OI or net capital flow or order-book OFI
